name: 针幕浮雕动画
palette: 纯黑、银灰与粉笔白的连续灰阶，严格不使用彩色
lighting: 单一低角度掠射光照亮可推拉金属针阵列，以针高形成浮雕阴影
optics: 浅浮雕式空间、雾化渐层与铜版画般细密颗粒，边缘由针影自然软化
composition: 梦境人物和环境从连续灰阶中浮现、溶解，前后层次依靠针阵列起伏而非线稿
camera_motion: slow relief emergence, shadow-field dissolve, subtle lateral drift, dreamlike depth breathing
style_instructions: Pinscreen animation made from a dense movable metal-pin field under raking light, producing monochrome bas-relief shadows, engraving-like gradients and dreamlike forms that emerge from darkness.
avoid_instructions: No paper ink linework, no pixel grid, no photographic film grain, no expressionist painted sets, no color tinting, no text or watermark.
